facts.answer: The release image supplies the missing runtime dependencies, including redis, and default configuration; the existing Docker entrypoint and test environment variables can still be reused. R2024.09-contract-r1: the PHP in the release stage can load redis, pdo_sqlite, pdo_mysql, pdo_pgsql, gd, mbstring, bcmath, dom, and openssl; how packages are organized is not part of the application contract. Redis defaults to 127.0.0.1:6379, SESSION_LIFETIME to 120 minutes, and CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY to true; explicit environment overrides are allowed. Keep the existing entrypoint; initialize on first startup, do not repeat destructive data operations on subsequent starts of the same version, and perform necessary upgrades when the version changes; preserve /srv/storage and SQLite data, and bind the installation marker to the version commit. The test environment still supports in-memory SQLite, array session/cache, and running without network access.
